_comment: Hooks for the claude-code adapter. Easiest: run `python3 install.py` (auto-fills the absolute path + baselines). To install by hand, merge this block into ~/.claude/settings.json and replace /ABS/PATH/TO/memory-agent with your clone's absolute path, then run `python3 mem.py capture --baseline` ONCE. SessionStart injects memory; SessionEnd/PreCompact enqueue the session (compute-free).
